title: Subwoofer and Amplifier Unit Removal and Refitting
introduction:
For vehicles with SYNC 2/SYNC 3, this procedure removes the illustrated subwoofer unit after taking off its lower cover and disconnecting the electrical connection behind it.

I read these drawings from the outside inward: cover first, enclosure mountings next, rear connector before the unit leaves its position. The bass box may get the musical glory, but its mounting bolts and wiring still deserve a careful exit. Blue marks the part being removed, magenta identifies the fasteners or connector, and the rear inset shows where the electrical disconnection happens.

The instructions cover removal and refitting of the illustrated unit, with separate tightening values for the cover and enclosure mountings.

items.name: Disable remote start
items.detail: Before service around the vehicle, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could start remotely at any time, causing personal injury or death.

items.name: Remove the key
items.detail: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from starting the engine during service. Accidental starting can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Eye, ear and hand protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling pointed or sharp-edged components. Failure to use the applicable protection may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Torque wrench
items.detail: Have a torque wrench suitable for the specified inch-pound values. The cover and the enclosure mountings use different tightening values; match each value to its illustrated fastener group.

edits.text: NOTE: Removal steps may also contain installation instructions. Read them before disassembly and keep them available for refitting.
edits.why: The tightening values shown during removal are needed when the corresponding fasteners go back in.

edits.text: Remove the highlighted bolts, then remove the subwoofer speaker cover in the direction shown. On installation, tighten the cover bolts to 21 lb.in (2.4 Nm).
edits.why: The blue part in this drawing is the lower cover beneath the speaker. Taking it off exposes the lower enclosure mountings used in the next operation; the cover fasteners are a separate group from those mountings.

edits.text: Remove the subwoofer mounting bolts in the illustrated order, disconnect the electrical connector shown in the rear inset, then remove the subwoofer speaker assembly.
edits.why: The drawing separates the upper mounting bolt from the lower bracket bolts. I use its rear inset to locate the connector at the finned module before moving the assembly away, so the wiring does not become an accidental tether.

edits.text: On installation, tighten the upper mounting bolt to 93 lb.in (10.5 Nm).
edits.why: This value belongs to the upper fastener identified by the first mounting callout in the enclosure drawing.

edits.text: On installation, tighten the lower bracket mounting bolts to 93 lb.in (10.5 Nm).
edits.why: This value belongs to the lower mounting group identified by the second callout, rather than the removable cover.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: position the subwoofer speaker assembly, reconnect its electrical connector, reinstall the mounting bolts, then refit the cover and its bolts. Use the tightening values given with each fastener group.
edits.why: The electrical connection must be restored before the unit and cover conceal it again. Keeping the enclosure and cover fastener groups separate makes their different tightening requirements easy to apply.
